tips.text: Research in a small Ghost-tier clan; bigger clans multiply the research costs.
Start the Detonite Injector and Grinlok research first and gather resources during the two 72 hour timers.
Rebuild a destroyed Chem Lab to reach finished research; the research is not lost.
Rank the Grinlok to 30 before building the Argonak, which consumes one.
Nobody finds the Grinlok hard; the wait is two 72 hour research timers.
